Name: Witch Hats
Author: 7yrsofbadluck
Description:
[b][size=4]Fashion Sense[/size][/b]
xnb replacers are incredibly outdated. But the Lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108478153]kailey2001[/url] has made these hats compatible with Fashion Sense! Go check it out! [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13735/]Witch Hats (Fashion Sense)[/url]

[b]WARNING:[/b] Do not download this mod from any place other than NexusMods! [url=http://www.stardewvalleymods.net/]WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET[/url] STEALS MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. [b]DO NOT download any mods there! [/b]If you see my mods anywhere other than Nexus, please link me to the site asap. Thank you!

My own variation of some witch hats for the game. I may add more if I have the time, but for right now it's just these three. 

[size=3]- Files -[/size]

So there are currently three hats, and four files.

[b]Plain Witch[/b] - Just a simple witch hat, no more no less. [b]Replaces[/b] - [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Good_Ol%27_Cap]G[/url][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Good_Ol%27_Cap]ood Ol' Cap[/url]

[b]Flower Witch[/b] - Who doesn't want a cute little flower on their hat? [b]Replaces[/b] - [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Good_Ol%27_Cap]G[/url][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Good_Ol%27_Cap]ood Ol' Cap[/url]

[b]Forest Witch[/b] - A bit of moss or vine instead of a ribbon to show off your natural witchy prowess. [b]Replaces[/b] - [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Good_Ol%27_Cap]G[/url][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Good_Ol%27_Cap]ood Ol' Cap[/url]  

[b]All The Hats[/b] - Because lets face it, who can choose just one! [b]Replaces[/b] - Plain-[url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Good_Ol%27_Cap]G[/url][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Good_Ol%27_Cap]ood Ol' Cap[/url]  Flower-[url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Cool_Cap]Cool Cap[/url]  Forest-[url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Trucker_Hat]Trucker Hat[/url]

[size=4]BE AWARE[/size]

This will replace the hats.xnb which means any other hat mods you have installed. If you know how to edit xnb files then feel free to add it to your own file. Now As for the hats they replace, I chose hats that suit me, but may not suit others. So again if I have time I may make some other files at peoples request. 

[size=3]- Credit - [/size]
[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/lemonex.28207/]LemonEX[/url], The creator of [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/posts/2882838/]Medieval/Traditional Hats Replacing[/url]. I used assets from their hat replacers to help make these so credit where credit's due.
